---
name: New alarm or fault
about: Propose an alarm to score or a sensor fault to inject
---

**Alarm or fault**

**Published source** (citation and DOI; values taken from it need `# SOURCE:` markers)

**Inputs** (CGM only, or also insulin and carbs on board)

**Causal?** (an alarm may use only data up to the current time)

**How it enters the benchmark**
- [ ] Plug-in alarm or stretch alarm: changes no published number
- [ ] Pre-registered set or default fault suite: changes results and needs an amendment first (AGENTS.md rule 11)

**What you expect it to change** (lows caught, false alarms per day by cause, minutes of warning)
